in_sanskrit.name: हिनया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'hin' meaning 'shining' or 'radiant', and the suffix '-aya' meaning 'goddess' or 'female deity'. This name can be interpreted as 'Goddess of Radiance' or 'Radiant Goddess'.

in_hindi.name: हिनया
in_hindi.long_meaning: From the Hindi words 'shubhra' meaning 'shining' or 'radiant', and '-aya' meaning 'goddess' or 'female deity'. This name can be interpreted as 'Radiant Goddess' or 'Goddess of Shining Light'.

in_tamil.name: ஹினயா
in_tamil.long_meaning: From the Tamil words 'kiṙambi' meaning 'shining' or 'radiant', and '-āy' meaning 'goddess' or 'female deity'. This name can be interpreted as 'Radiant Goddess' or 'Goddess of Shining Light'.

in_telugu.name: హిన్యా
in_telugu.long_meaning: From the Telugu words 'shubhra' meaning 'shining' or 'radiant', and '-yā' meaning 'goddess' or 'female deity'. This name can be interpreted as 'Radiant Goddess' or 'Goddess of Shining Light'.

in_marathi.name: Hinaya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Hini's Grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hinaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Hini’, meaning ‘she who is free’. This name is associated with the graceful and benevolent Goddess Hini, who is known for her compassion and wisdom. Hinaya embodies the strength and grace of this ancient deity.
